Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Seu papel:


Como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolvimento de Pipelines Escaláveis: Criar e manter processos de ingestão de dados altamente eficientes (Batch, Streaming, CDC) para grandes volumes, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e resiliência dos dados.
  • Modelagem e Otimização: Projetar, implementar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Data Lake/Lakehouse, orientadas à governança e que atendam às necessidades estratégicas dos times de Analytics e Negócios.
  • Qualidade e Governança: Desenvolver e manter processos de tratamento, aplicando frameworks avançados de validação (como DQX) e garantindo a qualidade e acessibilidade dos dados.
  • Monitoramento e Suporte: Implementar ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento contínuo para garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e conformidade do Data Lake, atuando de forma proativa na resolução de problemas.
  • Liderança Técnica em Governança: Liderar a implantação e utilização do Catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas de governança de dados.


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com as seguintes experiências e conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo e experiência prática na aplicação de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse.
  • Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (scripts, automações, ETL/ELT, PySpark, Pandas) e SQL avançado (tuning de queries, modelagem, window functions).
  • Nuvem Azure: Experiência avançada com o ecossistema Azure, incluindo Data Factory, Databricks e Data Lake .
  • Engenharia Essencial: Sólida experiência em arquiteturas distribuídas e padrões de ingestão de dados (Batch, Streaming, CDC).
  • Governança de Dados e DataOps: Experiência em catalogação, linhagem, qualidade e aplicação dos princípios de DataOps e DMBoK .
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD com ferramentas como Github .
  • Segurança da Informação: Conhecimento e aplicação da camada de segurança (criptografia, LGPD e mascaramento de dados).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Comunicação Eficaz, Empatia e Colaboração (Interação com Squads).
  • Senso de Urgência e Proatividade no contexto técnico.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas complexos, através de visão analítica e raciocínio lógico.
  • Flexibilidade e Resiliência em cenários de alta complexidade.
  • Paixão pela Qualidade e Visão Holística do negócio.




Diferenciais:

Estes itens não são mandatórios, mas serão considerados um bônus para a posição Sênior:

  • Experiência em Liderança Técnica e/ou Arquitetura de Projetos .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL Server (SSMS, SSIS e SSAS) e ferramentas de visualização como Power BI .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em análise funcional, modelagem de dados e elaboração de documentação técnica de soluções.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de três camadas, ambiente as a service, barramento (BUS) e orquestração.
  • Experiência com API’s para envio e recepção de informações e ferramentas como Excel no contexto de dados.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Azure DevOps
description:
Vertex Agility is a global tech consultancy known for delivering high-impact cloud and engineering solutions. We work with leading enterprises on modern, scalable platforms — and we’re looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer to join us on a contract basis.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Azure deployments using Terraform (env0 preferred)
  • Manage Azure networking, identities, Key Vault, firewalls
  • Deploy/manage SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB
  • Support Azure OpenAI & Cognitive Search integrations
  • Build CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Automate infra with reusable IaC modules
  • Set up monitoring (Datadog, App Insights)
  • Troubleshoot live deployments and collaborate with engineering teams


What You Need

  • Strong Azure + Terraform expertise
  • Experience with Entra ID, Managed Identities, Okta
  • Solid understanding of DNS, firewalls, cloud security
  • DB experience: SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps
  • Linux + Bash/PowerShell scripting
  • Strong written & spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Azure or Terraform certifications
  • Enterprise consulting/contracting experience


Remote role | US Eastern Time overlap required

title: Consultor Senior ERP
description:
Na LatamReady, somos a referência na implementação de Oracle NetSuite para empresas em expansão em toda a América Latina. Não apenas implementamos software; transformamos negócios e os ajudamos a escalar. Para continuar esta missão, buscamos incorporar ao nosso time Consultores(as) ERP Sênior de alto calibre.


Sua Missão como Consultor(a) ERP Sênior:


Você será peça-chave na otimização dos processos de negócio de nossos clientes através da implementação e consultoria especializada em soluções ERP. Seu conhecimento em sistemas como SAP (Business One, S/4HANA), Microsoft Dynamics (AX, NAV, 365), Oracle (EBS, JD Edwards) ou, idealmente, Oracle NetSuite, será fundamental para desenhar e implementar soluções que gerem impacto real.


O Que Esperamos de Você?


  • Domínio Comprovado em ERPs (+5 anos Implementando ERPs): Precisamos da sua experiência tangível no ciclo completo de projetos ERP: desde a análise de necessidades, design da solução, configuração, até a implantação e o suporte pós-implementação. Não basta conhecer a teoria; buscamos resultados comprovados.
  • Visão de Negócio: Você entenderá os desafios e objetivos de negócio dos nossos clientes para traduzir suas necessidades em soluções ERP funcionais e eficientes que agreguem valor quantificável.
  • Capacidade de Execução: Liderará e executará projetos de implementação, assegurando a qualidade, o cumprimento de prazos e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Comunicação Direta e Eficaz: Você se comunicará com clareza e precisão tanto com as equipes técnicas quanto com os níveis diretivos dos nossos clientes.
  • Inglês Avançado Indispensável: A interação com equipes e documentação internacional é constante. Um nível de inglês avançado, tanto oral quanto escrito, é um fator determinante para o sucesso nesta posição.


O Que Você Terá ao se Juntar à LatamReady?


  • A oportunidade de trabalhar com empresas líderes e em crescimento em toda a região.
  • Projetos desafiadores que permitirão aplicar sua expertise e gerar um impacto real.
  • Ser parte de uma organização focada na excelência, com um profundo conhecimento de Oracle NetSuite e do mercado latino-americano.
  • Um ambiente onde sua contribuição direta para o sucesso de nossos clientes é o principal indicador de seu desempenho.
  • Compensação competitiva e desenvolvimento profissional na principal solução Cloud ERP do mundo.


Se você é um(a) Consultor(a) ERP com profundo conhecimento em sistemas ERP, clara orientação a resultados, domina o inglês em nível avançado e está pronto(a) para levar sua carreira ao próximo nível em um ambiente dinâmico e focado, esta é sua oportunidade!


Próximos Passos:

Candidate-se aqui! Estamos buscando os melhores. Mostre-nos que é você.

title: Business Development Manager - LatAm Focus
description:
The Mandate: Forging New Paths to Prosperity


We are seeking a full-time BDM with a proven client portfolio and the confidence to open entirely new markets for our portfolio.


✅ Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Client Acquisition: Proactively develop and secure new clients, with a sharp focus on expanding Fa Chai Gaming's presence and securing major deals across Central and South America.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy: Submit regular, insightful reports on regional business developments and market trends, providing actionable recommendations to guide our strategic decision-making and product adaptation.
  • Ambassador & Host: Represent Fa Chai Gaming at key iGaming exhibitions and industry events, adeptly hosting clients and nurturing new business relationships face-to-face.
  • Relationship Nurturing: Undertake periodic business trips across the region to maintain and deepen strategic client relationships, ensuring high client satisfaction and sustained commercial growth.


What Brings You Fortune (Requirements & Skills)


  • Language Mastery: Demonstrated proficiency in both English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus).
  • Industry Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional sales experience in the online gaming/iGaming B2B sector.
  • Existing Client Resources: Must possess an established and active network of operator contacts within the LatAm market, with a proven ability to convert leads into major commercial partnerships.
  • Industry Preference: Candidates with previous sales or business development experience working for established European or American gaming providers/platforms will be strongly preferred.
  • Market Expertise: A deep understanding of the regulatory landscape, operator needs, and player preferences within the Central and South American market is a strong advantage.
  • Location Advantage: A current base of operations within Brazil or a major LatAm market hub is highly desirable.


Are you ready to build a new empire for Fa Chai Gaming and take the lead in LatAm?


If you have the network, the drive, and the ambition to succeed in a fast-paced environment where growth is the ultimate metric, apply now.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Atuamos em parceria com uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial , referência em inovação, sustentabilidade e gestão responsável. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor SAP Fiori para atuação temporária até dezembro , com possibilidade de prorrogação .

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Sr Java Developer
description:
Altimetrik is a leading digital business enablement company. Our agile professionals and engineering teams craft innovative solutions that drive transformation and growth for businesses worldwide.


Are you ready to join an exceptional team and company? This is your opportunity to elevate your career with Altimetrik .


Full-Time Position: Sr. Java Developer.

Location: Remote (Candidates must be based in Brazil).

English Level: Advanced (B2+/C1).


What You’ll Do

• Development and testing of critical backend services

• Contribute to architectural and product design decisions

• Translate functional requirements into effective technical solutions

• Deliver highly available services in production environments


Requirements

• 7+ years experience in Java application development, distributed systems, and highly available and scalable applications.

• Very good knowledge of Java Core and J2EE and should have worked on high availability, low latency platforms.

• Strong object-oriented programming skills in Java.

• Great experience with Microservices architecture.

• Experience with cloud native development projects, with any cloud provider, AWS is preferable.

• Understanding on basic algorithms implementation and their performance measurement.

• Ability to question status quo and identify bad design/code patterns which can impact performance and maintainability of the code.

• Proficient understanding of system design and design patterns.

• Good experience in the Spring framework.

• Some experience in SQL and NoSQL

• Have very good communication skills.

• Previous experience with the Agile methodolog

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Altimetrik is a digital business enablement company. Our agile professionals and engineering teams create solutions that drive innovation and transformation for businesses.


Do you want to be part of a great team and company? This is an opportunity to boost your career with Altimetrik Brazil.


We are seeking a skilled FullStack Developer.


Requirements:


  • English Advanced (B2 / C1).
  • 5+ year experience in JavaScript, React, NodeJS, AWS, and understanding of how a solution ties together.
  • Strong JavaScript development skills with a specialization in microservices running inside a Docker container in a cloud environment (preferably on AWS including but not limited to ECS, EKS).

The consultant will be responsible for validating end-to-end payroll processing across Workday and ADP (GlobalView / Workforce Now / Celergo), ensuring data accuracy, compliance with payroll rules, and a smooth transition to the new payroll landscape. This role requires strong hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions, deep understanding of gross-to-net calculations, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in HR, Payroll, and IT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and execute test cases for Workday-to-ADP payroll integrations, including end-to-end payroll cycles.
  • Validate payroll processing results, including earnings, deductions, taxes, and gross-to-net calculations across ADP platforms.
  • Review and validate data mapping and transformations between Workday and ADP (GlobalView, Workforce Now, or Celergo).
  • Test inbound and outbound interface files between Workday and ADP, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to defined formats.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for payroll-related processes.
  • Log, track, and document defects using the client’s defect management tools, working with technical and functional teams to drive timely resolution.
  • Support parallel payroll testing cycles by comparing legacy and new payroll results, identifying and analyzing variances.
  • Collaborate closely with Workday configuration teams, ADP SMEs, payroll operations, and project managers to clarify requirements, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain test documentation, including test plans, scripts, scenarios, and status reports.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, and templates for payroll transformation projects.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions.
  • Practical experience with one or more of the following: ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, and/or ADP Workforce Now.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll rules, calculations, and end-to-end gross-to-net processing (earnings, deductions, benefits, taxes).
  • Experience testing payroll integrations, including validation of inbound and outbound interface files.
  • Ability to design and execute test cases, analyze results, and document defects in a structured way.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, global environments with HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of Workday payroll configuration and Workday payroll interface (WPI) or similar Workday outbound interfaces.
  • Experience with large-scale payroll transformation or migration projects.
  • Prior experience working with global payroll across multiple countries and legal entities.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and working within structured project frameworks.

Engagement Details

This is a contract position supporting Kyndryl on a Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation initiative. Candidates may be based in the US, Brazil, or India and must be comfortable collaborating with distributed, multicultural teams located in multiple time zones.

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate

Job Type: Full-time, Freelancer Position

Location: Remote - Brazil - Work from home


**** Resumes must be submitted in English for consideration ****

On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate .

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's 2021 Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world. They are adding new members to their Brazilian team.


Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal , you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures. You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures.


This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients’ day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client’s preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client’s desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported hardware, Minglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal’s standard help desk procedures according to each client’s agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM/CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients’ employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients’ employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

  • Proficient and professional/native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile/wireless industry a plus


What Mindglobal offers:

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.


Job Type: Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position. Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided. You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked. You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays. If desired, you can be paid in US Dollars.


Compensation & Hours:

Pay: $5.50 USD per hour (at 42 hours/week this equates to $1000 USD/month)


Hours: Set schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am OR Saturday - Wednesday, 6:30am - 3:30pm OR Monday - Friday 9am - 6pm (Austin, TX, Central Time)


Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas


Idioma:

  • English (Obrigatório)

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Fractional Head of Product (Consultancy Scaling & Strategy)
description:
About Us:

We are a fast-growing software consultancy with a reputation for excellence. We have successfully scaled to a 20-project portfolio, and we are now looking for a strategic partner to help us build the systems and frameworks that will power the next phase of our growth.


This is a unique, high-impact opportunity for a seasoned product leader to step in as a fractional executive, partnering directly with the CEO to architect and implement our new "Scalable Ownership Framework."


Your Impact (The Mission):

This is not an operational project management role. You are not the "single point of ownership" for 20 projects. Your mission is to be our internal strategic leader and systems-builder. You will provide the "big picture" audit and direction, ensuring our product vision and project health are aligned as we scale.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the Process: You will be the primary architect and implementer of our new "Scalable Ownership Framework." This involves grouping projects into logical pods and defining the standards, rituals, and roles that empower our team to execute with clarity.
  • Mentor & Empower Our Leaders: You will act as a "Group Product Manager," providing direct mentorship, coaching, and strategic guidance to our Solution (Tech) Leads and Delivery Coordinators 11, upskilling them into true owners of their project pods.
  • Conduct Strategic Audits: You will perform the high-level "weekly audit+direction setting," reviewing portfolio health, identifying "loose ends," and ensuring the "big picture" product vision is being executed. You will be the strategic backstop for our CEO.
  • Partner with Delivery: You will collaborate closely with our client-facing engagement and delivery leads, acting as the internal champion for product quality, technical health, and process integrity, providing a healthy strategic balance to commercial goals.


What We're Looking For (Qualifications):

  • Extensive Experience (5-10+ years): A proven background in a software development agency, consultancy, or a product-led B2B SaaS company is essential. You have seen this scaling challenge before.
  • Product Ownership Mastery: Deep expertise in creating frameworks for product backlogs, user stories, and prioritization. You are a master of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) in the reality of a multi-project environment.
  • Proven "Builder" Mindset: You thrive on turning chaos into clarity. You are a pragmatic systems-thinker who defaults to building durable processes, not just fighting fires.
  • Exceptional Leadership & Mentorship: You are a "leader of leaders." You can confidently mentor and upskill existing team members, build consensus, and act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.
  • Strategic (not just Operational) Acumen: You have a deep, practical understanding of the commercial realities of a consultancy (SOWs, budgets, client relationships) and know how to partner with delivery teams to protect both client success and team health.


Engagement Model:

This is a long-term, fractional (part-time) strategic partnership.


Fluency in Portuguese in addition to English a plus

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.


Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!


We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Workspaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

Advanced English

title: AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python , with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn , and Hugging Face Transformers .
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks , voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices , including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning , GANs , or edge AI deployments .
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Consultor de vendas online
description:
❌Não vamos analisar currículos sem experiência na área

❌Avaga não é para quem quer só uma renda extra no Home Office


Somos uma agência de turismo 100% online e com foco na venda de passeios para Santiago do Chile e Deserto do Atacama e Peru.


Precisamos de um consultor de vendas PJ com experiência em vendas através do WhatsApp (Não iremos entrevistar quem não tiver experiência na área de vedas).


A vaga será para período integral e você poderá trabalhar 100% de forma remota. A contratação será de forma PJ.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Vender de forma consultivas os passeios para Santiago do Chile e Deserto de Atacama;
  • Organização dos processos e cumprimento dos prazos combinados;


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Para ser Consultor(a) de vendas é importante:
  • Ter vontade de vender e ser motivado por metas;
  • Ter uma ótima organização;
  • Habilidade de atuar com metas e orientação para resultados;
  • Boa comunicação e lidar bem com público;
  • Agilidade no atendimento e respostas;
  • Facilidade de memorização e aprendizagem;
  • Proatividade.


Disponibilidade de trabalho entre 09:00 e 18:00 com 1h de almoço (com intercalações em fins de semanas e turnos da noite);

Disponibilidade para trabalhar com escala em fins de semana e feriados;

Ter CNPJ (vaga PJ);

Ter notebook e microfone em casa;


Remuneração

  • Fixo de R$ 2.000 (negociável) + Percentual variável de acordo com a meta sobre todas as vendas + Bônus de até R$900 por metas batidas. Oportunidade de crescimento na liderança de equipe.

title: Gerente de Projetos de TI Sênior (Inglês Fluente)
description:
A Stefanini LATAM está em busca de um Gerente de Projetos Sênior bilíngue para atuar diretamente com um de nossos Gerentes Comerciais, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas em clientes globais, especialmente no universo de Dados e IA .

Trata-se de um papel crucial, combinando atuação como PM hands-on e parceiro PMO , garantindo governança, visibilidade e entrega estruturada de múltiplos projetos.


Modelo de Contratação

  • Contratação: Contractor / PJ via Deel - Stefanini LATAM
  • Dedicação: Full-time (exclusivo)
  • Local: 100% Remoto
  • Projeto de longa duração


O profissional ideal tem experiência sólida em gestão de ponta a ponta, alta capacidade de comunicação em inglês e habilidade em traduzir progresso, riscos e próximos passos para stakeholders de alto nível.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o ciclo completo de projetos (possivelmente em iniciativas de Dados e IA);
  • Atuar como braço direito de um Gerente Comercial, garantindo alinhamento, governança e entregas estruturadas;
  • Executar atividades de PMO: reports consolidados, acompanhamento de progresso, documentação, gestão de riscos e issues.
  • Facilitar cerimônias e workshops (Lean Inception, práticas Ágeis, etc.).
  • Coordenar times multifuncionais e assegurar cumprimento de prazos, escopo e orçamento.
  • Comunicar-se com excelência em inglês (oral e escrito).


Requisitos

  • 7+ anos de experiência como Gerente de Projetos ou PMO em ambientes de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e Cascata.
  • Experiência prática com Lean Inception .
  • Inglês fluente (C1+).
  • Experiência prévia com clientes de grande porte/globais.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos fluxos e consolidar informações de forma clara.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações PMP , Scrum Master , PMO ou similares.
  • Vivência em projetos de Dados, Analytics, IA ou ecossistemas tecnológicos complexos.



Se você é um líder de entrega estruturado, com excelente comunicação e paixão por organizar e impulsionar projetos estratégicos, queremos conversar com você!

title: Azure Devops Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain cloud-native solutions across our Retail technology landscape. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to align DevOps practices with business goals, supporting ITIL processes, and ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and manage CI/CD pipelines for Retail applications.
  • Deploy and operate containerized workloads using AKS and Kubernetes.
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, integrations, and application environments.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, ARM templates, and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
  • Implement observability and alerting using Azure Monitor and Grafana.
  • Support incident, problem, and change management processes.
  • Ensure cloud security, vulnerability management, and networking troubleshooting.
  • Perform SQL-based tasks and support BI/reporting workflows.
  • Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years in technology with strong DevOps and Azure cloud expertise.
  • Deep knowledge of Azure services, AKS, networking, security, storage, databases, and containerization.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab).
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, PowerShell, C#, Java, etc.).
  • Proficient with SQL Server and BI tools (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS).
  • Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible, Chef).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills; familiarity with SRE and ITIL practices.

Desired Qualifications

  • Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • Experience working with retail or wholesale trading systems

title: Medical Assistant
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM) – Full-Time

Salary: USD 750–800 per month (≈ USD 4.7/hr)

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

Equipment Required: Computer/laptop + reliable internet


Overview

We are seeking a Virtual Assistant / Front Office Call Center Coordinator to join a fast-paced, multi-specialty medical facility serving patients across Neurology, Mental Health, Hormone Therapy, and Ketamine Therapy. Our client is committed to delivering exceptional, patient-centered care, and this role is key to ensuring smooth operations and outstanding patient experiences.

As the first point of contact for many patients, you will handle high-volume calls, schedule appointments across multiple providers, update EMR systems, and resolve patient inquiries with empathy and professionalism.


Responsibilities

Patient Scheduling & Coordination

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel appointments across multiple clinics and providers.
  • Manage scheduling changes, follow-ups, reminders, and patient rescheduling.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff to ensure smooth patient flow and minimize delays.

Patient Communication & Support

  • Answer a high volume of incoming calls with professionalism and urgency.
  • Provide information about services, treatment plans, and appointment details.
  • Assist patients with questions, concerns, and general inquiries.
  • Handle upset or confused patients with empathy, patience, and clear communication.
  • Make outbound calls for reminders, confirmations, and follow-ups.

Administrative & EMR Management

  • Update and maintain accurate patient records in Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems.
  • Use scheduling software to manage calendars across multiple providers.
  • Perform administrative support tasks to assist front office operations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and timely entry of patient information.


Requirements

  • Advanced English (written and spoken); bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
  • 1+ year of experience in call centers, customer service, or front-desk roles within the healthcare sector .
  • Experience handling high-volume calls and assisting patients with inquiries, rescheduling, and support.
  • Familiarity with EMR systems and scheduling software .
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Excellent communication skills, customer service mindset, and professional phone etiquette.
  • High attention to detail, accurate data entry, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empathy, patience, and strong problem-solving abilities when dealing with patients.
  • Tech-savvy; comfortable learning new systems.
  • Reliable computer/laptop with camera and microphone + stable internet connection.

title: Engenheiro Machine Learning Sênior
description:
Engenheiro de Machine Learning Senior


Requisitos:

Experiência sólida com engenharia de software aplicada a dados e machine learning.

Proficiência em Python e frameworks como PySpark, Pandas, Scikit-learn ou similares.

Experiência com ferramentas e serviços AWS, como S3, Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, Athena, SageMaker ou ECS.

Conhecimento em MLOps e CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos.

Experiência com orquestração de workflows.

Capacidade de escrever código limpo, modular e testável.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation).

Participação em projetos de ML em produção com foco em confiabilidade e rastreabilidade.


Responsabilidades principais:

Projetar e implementar pipelines de validação de dados e avaliação de modelos em ambiente cloud (AWS).

Integrar dados e métricas de avaliação em um fluxo automatizado e auditável.

Modularizar o pipeline para facilitar reuso, testes e manutenção.

Trabalhar em colaboração com times de Data Science, Engenharia de Dados e Produto.

Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, logging, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Propor melhorias contínuas na arquitetura de dados e nos processos de validação.


Modelo de atuação: Remoto

As an operations specialist, you will monitor ongoing delivery routes and communicate with delivery drivers and shippers over the phone and live chat.


Requirements

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Position : Senior Software Engineer – Frontend (ReactJS / Svelte)

Location : Remote Brazil

Duration: 12+ months

Rate : DOE


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer – Frontend to join our dynamic engineering team. You will collaborate closely with Product, QA, and Backend teams to deliver a best-in-class user experience that entertains millions of users across multiple OTT platforms and devices. The ideal candidate is passionate about building high-performance, scalable frontend applications and thrives in a fast-paced agile environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Backend teams to deliver high-quality user experiences.
  • Design and develop frontend features using ReactJS and/or Svelte.
  • Build and support applications for OTT platforms and Smart TV devices.
  • Integrate REST APIs and ensure optimal performance across low-resource devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and work in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Document features, workflows, and technical processes.


Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of software development experience.
  • 3+ years of ReactJS and/or Svelte experience.
  • 1+ year of TypeScript experience.
  • Experience with OTT / Smart TV / Connected TV application development.
  • Strong knowledge of frontend performance optimization and debugging.
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Vite, Webpack, Nx, or Rspack.
  • Proven ability to work with high-traffic applications and REST APIs.

title: Analista de segurança
description:
Required Skills and Experience:

The ideal candidate will bring foundational experience in security operations with a demonstrated ability to investigate and respond to security events. A strong focus on Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is essential, including the ability to analyze data movement, enforce classification standards, and coordinate remediation efforts. Candidates should be comfortable working in dynamic environments, applying core SOC concepts while developing deeper expertise in protecting sensitive data.


  • Experience in cybersecurity or information technology within a SOC or incident response role.
  • Hands-on experience working with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and processes.
  • Familiarity with common data classification categories (e.g., PII, PCI, PHI) and their security and compliance implications.
  • Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems for monitoring, triage, and analysis.
  • Exposure to endpoint protection solutions, including antivirus, EDR, or other detection and response technologies.
  • Experience triaging security incidents in cloud-native and SaaS environments .
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP protocols and OSI Layers 1–4.
  • Ability to analyze event logs and alerts, correlate them with DLP activity, and determine the appropriate remediation.
  • Basic knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), Cyber Kill Chain, and MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting incidents and working with stakeholders during investigations.
  • Ability to maintain integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive data.
  • Highly organized, efficient, and capable of managing multiple incidents or tasks with minimal supervision.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience tuning or refining DLP policies and rules to improve accuracy and reduce false positives.
  • Familiarity with cloud security controls and data governance concepts (e.g., encryption, access control, retention).
  • Exposure to cybersecurity threat hunting techniques and proactive analysis methods.
  • Basic scripting or automation knowledge (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar) to support repetitive triage tasks.


Education/Certifications/Training Required:

  • Basic industry certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or GIAC.
  • Associates' or Bachelors’ Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security Assurance, or equivalent experience.

title: Dev. Fullstack - Sênior (Integrações)
description:
Somos uma startup que nasceu com o propósito de simplificar a vida dos donos de restaurantes, oferecendo integração com as principais plataformas de delivery e uma solução completa que conecta diferentes frentes da gestão desde pedidos até controle de estoque e fluxo de caixa.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa de Fullstack para atuar de forma estratégica em nosso time, garantindo que nossas soluções acompanhem o ritmo de crescimento e mantenham os mais altos padrões de qualidade.


Requisitos:


  • NodeJS, Angular JS;
  • Container (Docker, Kubernetes), banco de Dados PostgreSQL (SQL Server), e Git (bitbucket);
  • Experiência em Desenvolvimento Ágil (Scrum, Kanban, outros);
  • Desenvolvimento Cloud AWS (SQS, Lambda, ECS, S3, Dynamo)
  • +5 anos de experiência.



Desejável, mas não obrigatório:


  • Loopback 4 (framework);
  • Redis;
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful e webhooks;
  • Mapeamento e transformação de dados (DE-PARA);
  • Processamento assíncrono (ex: AWS SQS) e tolerância a falhas;
  • Experiência com integrações de APIs;
  • Testes de integração, troubleshooting e monitoramento de APIs;
  • Segurança em comunicação entre sistemas (OAuth, autenticação);



Benefícios:


  • Contratação PJ com período de descanso remunerado de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio Home Office (no cartão Caju) de R$180/mês;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Day off no mês do aniversário;
  • Desconto Gympass;
  • Kit completo de equipamentos de trabalho;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

title: Marketing Product Manager
description:
Job Responsibilities：

1. Conduct industry market research, demand analysis and competitive analysis in the target region and country, explore new products that match market demands or new application opportunities based on existing products, and promptly feedback to the company headquarters.

2. Be responsible for the research, planning and analysis of business requirements, convert business requirements into product requirements, and write product requirement specification documents.

3. Assist the product launch, support the sales team to complete the new product launch promotion work, support the product sales target.

4. Be responsible for the life cycle management of the product, including providing support and coordination for the operation plans and promotion plans in the early, middle and late stages of product launch.

5. Responsible for analyzing customer demand feedback and understanding internal demands, tracking product operation data, analyzing user feedback, formulating standardized product packages, and optimizing and iterating plans.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or above, majoring in science and engineering or related fields.

2. More than three years of working experience as a product manager, with experience in the analysis of the testing and analysis instrument industry or agricultural markets such as feed and grain and oil crops.

3. Possessing excellent learning ability, one can quickly learn and understand the company's products and applications.

4. Strong logical thinking ability, good insight and analytical skills, capable of observing products and identifying opportunities from both customer needs and market opportunities perspectives simultaneously.

5. Fluent in English and able to travel for frequent business trips within the region.

title: Full-Stack Go Engineer
description:
Own your future:

Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.

As a Full-Stack Go Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Go, JavaScript, and cloud technologies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build high-quality software solutions, optimize performance, and ensure reliability in a cloud-native infrastructure.


Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Go.
  • Experience and readiness to work with JavaScript (20% of the time)
  • Proficiency in Amazon Web Services (AWS), including deploying and maintaining cloud-based applications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
  • Upper-Intermediate+ English and ability to communicate effectively with international teams.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Dart
  • Experience and readiness to work with Python.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to both frontend and backend Scripting features.
  • Remediate the bug backlog.
  • Debug and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
  • Perform code reviews.
  • Establish key metrics to identify problems, suggest solutions, and drive resolution.
  • Engage with support teams in triaging and resolving production issues.
  • Participate in team Agile ceremonies.

title: Analista de Produtos e dados
description:
Vaga: Analista de Produtos e dados | Maitha Tech


Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Owner de Dados para atuar de forma estratégica na evolução dos produtos de dados da organização. Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções que geram impacto real, influenciando roadmap, governança e direcionamento técnico, além de fortalecer a cultura data-driven em toda a empresa.

É uma posição de alta visibilidade , interação frequente com stakeholders e forte atuação junto às equipes de Engenharia, Analytics e Negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a construção, evolução e priorização do roadmap dos produtos de dados.
  • Definir OKRs e métricas de sucesso, garantindo entregas de alto valor.
  • Traduzir demandas de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros para Engenharia de Dados.
  • Gerenciar backlog, alinhando necessidades de negócio ao desenvolvimento técnico.
  • Atuar lado a lado com times de Engenharia, Analytics e áreas de negócio.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da squad e promover melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de governança, segurança e compliance de dados.
  • Participar e facilitar cerimônias ágeis.
  • Acompanhar releases e comunicar evoluções às áreas parceiras.


✔ Requisitos

  • Ensino superior em TI, Dados, Engenharia, Negócios ou correlatas.
  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência como PO, Analista de Dados, Engenheiro de Dados ou funções similares.
  • Vivência forte com produtos orientados a dados e atuação com áreas de negócio.
  • Experiência com Scrum/Kanban , priorização de backlog e discovery.
  • Conhecimento em Data Lake ou Data Mesh , especialmente em AWS .
  • Noções sólidas de Engenharia de Dados: PySpark, Python, MongoDB, bancos de dados.
  • Vivência com Power BI .
  • Entendimento de infraestrutura e arquitetura de dados.
  • Familiaridade com OKRs e métricas de produto.
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico, adaptável, com pensamento crítico e senso de dono.


➕ Diferenciais

  • Noções de Machine Learning e IA aplicada a dados.
  • Conhecimento do negócio Alelo .
  • Vivência com governança, qualidade e catalogação de dados.
  • Experiência avançada com AWS .


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remoto


O que você encontrará na Maitha

  • Desenvolvimento individual de soft skills ao longo da jornada.
  • Gestão de bem-estar com indicadores e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Treinamentos, workshops e meetups para evolução técnica e comportamental.
  • Programa de recompensas e premiações.
  • TotalPass com diversas modalidades (musculação, yoga, dança, entre outros).
  • Muito mais em um ambiente colaborativo e de constante evolução!

  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);

  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Inglês avançado;
