title: ABAP Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


We are looking for a skilled ABAP Cloud Clean Core Developer to join our SAP team and support digital transformation initiatives in the pharmaceutical and life sciences sector.


The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in ABAP Cloud and RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model), with a solid understanding of Clean Core principles and the strict compliance standards that govern pharmaceutical operations. This role will involve building upgrade-safe, cloud-ready SAP solutions while ensuring regulatory compliance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain upgrade-safe, extensible solutions in SAP S/4HANA Cloud following Clean Core principles.
  • Use ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) to build modern, cloud-ready applications.
  • Ensure all developments are designed and documented in line with pharmaceutical compliance standards (GxP, CFR Part 11, validation protocols).
  • Collaborate with functional, quality, and compliance teams to deliver solutions that are both technically sound and audit-ready.
  • Develop APIs, CDS views, OData services, and integration scenarios that support regulated business processes.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA transformation projects within manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and regulatory domains.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and validation activities to ensure alignment with IT and QA requirements.
  • Stay current with SAP BTP extensibility, Clean Core roadmap, and pharma industry digital trends.


Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as an ABAP Developer, with strong expertise in ABAP Cloud and RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model).
  • Solid understanding of Clean Core principles and experience implementing upgrade-safe, extensible solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical compliance standards, including GxP, CFR Part 11, and validation protocols.
  • Experience developing APIs, CDS views, and OData services, as well as supporting complex integration scenarios.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams, including quality and compliance groups.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and regulatory domains in the pharma or life sciences industry is a strong plus.
  • Up-to-date understanding of SAP BTP extensibility and emerging trends in pharma industry digital transformation.


Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience working in pharma, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Knowledge of Fiori/UI5 development and integration.
  • Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) or cloud-based integrations.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and tools for SAP development lifecycle.


Benefits:

  • The opportunity to contribute to a global leader in supply chain innovation and digital transformation.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment

title: Desenvolvedor em Copilot Studio / IA Aplicada ao Desenvolvimento PL
description:
Modelo de trabalho: (remoto)

Senioridade: (Pleno)

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Copilot Studio para atuar na construção, integração e evolução de soluções que utilizam copilots de IA voltados ao desenvolvimento, automação e produtividade. O(a) profissional será responsável por aplicar ferramentas de IA generativa em práticas de engenharia de software, apoiar times na adoção dessas tecnologias e garantir o uso seguro e governado dos copilots.


Responsabilidades

  • Criar, configurar e evoluir soluções utilizando Copilot Studio .
  • Utilizar ferramentas como GitHub Copilot , Microsoft Copilot ou copilots similares para aumentar produtividade, qualidade e velocidade de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar equipes no uso de IA para geração, revisão e otimização de código.
  • Integrar copilots a fluxos de trabalho, processos de negócio e plataformas corporativas.
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento utilizando Git/GitHub .
  • Atuar com foco em segurança, governança, compliance e uso responsável de IA.
  • Colaborar com times de tecnologia e negócio para identificar oportunidades de automação com copilots.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática com Copilot Studio .
  • Vivência com GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot ou outras ferramentas de copilots de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento e produtividade.
  • Conhecimentos em uma ou mais linguagens relevantes: Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, etc.
  • ou experiência nas plataformas M365, Power Platform, Dynamics ou Azure .
  • Capacidade de criar, revisar e otimizar código com suporte de IA.
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de versionamento com Git/GitHub .
  • Noções de segurança , compliance e governança aplicadas a soluções de IA generativa.

Diferenciais (Desejável)

  • Experiência com integração de copilots em fluxos de trabalho e processos corporativos.
  • Certificações em IA, Azure, Power Platform ou GitHub.
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e engenharia de plataformas.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Sênior - Angular/Java
description:
Buscamos por um(a) Desenvolvedor FullStack Angular/Java p ara atuar em um cliente do segmento financeiro. A oportunidade é remota.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com Java (versões 8 a 21);
  • Domínio de Angular (versões atuais) com TypeScript;
  • Experiência em integração com APIs Java e arquitetura de microserviços;
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX, com foco em performance, responsividade e boas práticas de front-end;
  • Vivência com controle de versão (Git) e integração contínua (CI);
  • Capacidade de comunicação direta com times de back-end, especialmente com Java/Spring Boot e microservices.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter interfaces utilizando Angular e TypeScript;
  • Implementar novas funcionalidades consumindo APIs Java e microserviços;
  • Garantir performance, responsividade e boa experiência do usuário, aplicando boas práticas de UI/UX;
  • Colaborar com o time de back-end para definição de contratos de APIs, integrações e melhorias contínuas;
  • Realizar revisão de código (code review) e contribuir para a qualidade do produto;
  • Participar de rituais ágeis, propondo soluções técnicas e melhorias no fluxo de desenvolvimento;
  • Utilizar Git, pipelines de CI/CD e ferramentas de versionamento para manter o projeto organizado e escalável;
  • Monitorar e corrigir bugs, garantindo a estabilidade das aplicações.


Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso de nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores. Por isso, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, com oportunidades de crescimento profissional e valorização da cultura da empresa.


Vem construir soluções incríveis com a gente!

Buscamos por um(a) Desenvolvedor FullStack Angular/Java p ara atuar em um cliente do segmento financeiro. A oportunidade é remota.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com Java (versões 8 a 21);
  • Domínio de Angular (versões atuais) com TypeScript;
  • Experiência em integração com APIs Java e arquitetura de microserviços;
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX, com foco em performance, responsividade e boas práticas de front-end;
  • Vivência com controle de versão (Git) e integração contínua (CI);
  • Capacidade de comunicação direta com times de back-end, especialmente com Java/Spring Boot e microservices.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e manter interfaces utilizando Angular e TypeScript;
  • Implementar novas funcionalidades consumindo APIs Java e microserviços;
  • Garantir performance, responsividade e boa experiência do usuário, aplicando boas práticas de UI/UX;
  • Colaborar com o time de back-end para definição de contratos de APIs, integrações e melhorias contínuas;
  • Realizar revisão de código (code review) e contribuir para a qualidade do produto;
  • Participar de rituais ágeis, propondo soluções técnicas e melhorias no fluxo de desenvolvimento;
  • Utilizar Git, pipelines de CI/CD e ferramentas de versionamento para manter o projeto organizado e escalável;
  • Monitorar e corrigir bugs, garantindo a estabilidade das aplicações.


Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso de nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores. Por isso, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, com oportunidades de crescimento profissional e valorização da cultura da empresa.


Vem construir soluções incríveis com a gente!

title: Customer Service Representative - Relocation Required
description:
Vantage is a global, multi-regulated, multi-asset broker based in Sydney, offering clients access to trading CFDs on Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and Cryptocurrencies. With over 10 years of market experience, Vantage has a strong presence with more than 1,000 employees across 30 global offices. Vantage provides a trusted trading ecosystem and a user-friendly platform for clients to capitalize on trading opportunities.


OPEN ONLY to Portuguese native speakers who are willing to relocate.


This is a unique opportunity for Customer Service Rockstars interested in living and developing a career in Southeast Asia: Malaysia or Thailand . The company will provide all necessary visa assistance and relocation support. During the visa processing, work remotely from your base country.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide front-line support to our customers via live chats, phones, and email.
  • Answering queries and resolving client issues regarding our products, platforms, and promotions.
  • Address customer feedback as well as complaints professionally.
  • Record and update customer data and other relevant information when necessary.
  • Supporting documentation/administrative needs within the department and supporting translation for customer announcement notices.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree, fresh graduates welcome to apply.
  • Over 2 years of experience in Customer Service, highly preferred in crypto or fintech, but any industry welcome.
  • Mandatory rotation shift schedule with night-shifts once relocated.
  • Experience in international settings and teams.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is MANDATORY
  • Exceptional communication skills with a superb client focus.
  • Logical and analytical approach to problem-solving.
  • Knowledge or interest in trading is highly desirable, but not essential.


We offer :

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Remote work while relocation is processed
  • Local benefits according to the chosen relocation country
  • Relocation support, including visa sponsorship and additional expenses
  • Career development in a fast-paced industry

title: Python Developer - SR/PL
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

As a Python Developer, it is expected that the ideal candidate understands a broad range of computer science concepts and their applicability. This person can dive deeply into a wide range of technical problems, offering suggestions and feedback to their team and can also help to understand the requirements, and translate to an architectural design and help to plan and implement this solution for those requirements.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Actively support the development teams;
  • Mentor less experienced team members;
  • Drive team to innovate and deliver roadmap features with agility and high quality;
  • Digest requirements from product team and work on solutions with performance and scalability features for cloud systems;
  • Development of new features;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches by elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Participation in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, development, and testing;
  • Participation in technical discussions with customers;
  • Perform code reviews;
  • Conduct yourself as a trusted technical advisor;
  • Follow agile processes and participate actively in all development phases.


Essential Skills

  • Experience leading development teams;
  • Proficiency with development in Python versions 2 and 3;
  • Experience with pyTest;
  • Experience with Linux environments, CLI commands, Shell Script and logs;
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with GIT;
  • Experience with Github, GIT, code;
  • Knowledge of Agile development (e.g. using Scrum, Kanban, etc.).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • NETCONF/YANG.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

Our client is loong for a highly skilled Full Stack Engineer to join a global product-focused technology team responsible for building large-scale web platforms used by millions of users. This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, engineering-driven environment with strong ownership, modern cloud architectures, and end-to-end autonomy.


What You Will Do

  • Design and build responsive, web-based applications and learning tools used at scale.
  • Work closely with engineering, product, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver impactful user-centric features.
  • Own the full software development lifecycle: architecture, development, testing, deployment, observability, and maintenance.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code and monitoring best practices to ensure highly reliable applications.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing engineering group built around autonomy and extreme ownership.


What You Bring

Mandatory Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Java , ideally with Spring or Spring Boot.
  • Experience with Angular (preferred) or React.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful services , microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , automated testing, and DevOps-oriented workflows.
  • Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL).
  • Experience with AWS services for cloud-native application development.
  • Understanding of Docker and containerization concepts.
  • Experience with observability tools to monitor application health.
  • Solid understanding of backend engineering, with some experience across the full stack (front-end + backend).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Terraform (highly desirable).
  • Experience developing B2B or B2C product engineering solutions at scale.
  • Experience building accessible, high-performance, responsive web applications .
  • Knowledge of distributed caching solutions (e.g., Redis).
  • Experience deploying applications on Tomcat or similar application servers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

title: QA Engineer (Salesforce)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Quality Engineer to join their high-performing engineering organization as they continue to innovate and scale their global product suite. As a leader in tech scouting and innovation management software, our partner empowers the world's top companies and research institutions to accelerate discovery, collaboration, and operational excellence.


As an Al-First Quality Engineer, you will go beyond writing and executing test cases. You will harness the power of Al to predict defects, optimize test coverage, and accelerate delivery. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how intelligent quality practices are embedded into every stage of their software development lifecycle.


What You'll Do:

  • Use Al-driven tools to generate, maintain, and optimize test cases, test data, and test automation against application(s) running on the Salesforce Platform
  • Strategically prioritize and drive forward the QA practice with a high degree of autonomy

￮ Identify and propose strategies for technical and testing problems affecting the team, communicate standards clearly, and secure buy-in on solutions.

￮ Champion use of AI to automate repetitive and time-consuming QA tasks, freeing the team to focus on high-impact testing, exploratory scenarios, and strategic quality improvements

￮ Manage and mitigate technical and testing risk across projects, ensuring the right testing scope and sequencing to achieve team objectives and enable faster, safer releases.

￮ Leverage predictive analytics to identify defect-prone areas and prioritize risk-based testing.

  • Collaborate with developers, architects, and product managers to integrate Al-powered quality checks into CI/CD pipelines and unblock Al-powered workflows
  • Validate AI/ML based functionality for accuracy and reliability as part of the release process.


What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of proven experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles.

￮ Experience across the breadth of application testing types: end-to-end testing, load and volume performance testing, API testing, etc.

  • Proven experience with testing against the Salesforce Platform

￮ Understanding of platform and change management concepts: sandboxes, templates, packages, and changesets. Experience with Salesforce Second-Generation Managed Packages is strongly desired.

￮ Knowledge of platform limits and constraints to inform data volume testing

￮ Experience administering Salesforce and/or strong Salesforce configuration skills

  • Strong programming skills, with familiarity across several languages (C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, SQL, etc.).
  • Understanding of Al/ML concepts and hands-on experience using Al-enabled development and testing tools
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright preferred) and their intersection with Al tools (such as Playwright MCP Server)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud-native environments.
  • Self-driven work style, with initiative to exploring, learning, and applying novel concepts and techniques
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a mindset for experimentation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience in analyzing data sets for defect prediction, anomaly detection, or performing root cause analysis.


Work Schedule: You MUST be able to work during core U.S. Time Zone working hours.  


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a growing company at the forefront of Salesforce-driven enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

As a leader in tech scouting and innovation management software, our partner empowers the world's top companies and research institutions to accelerate discovery, collaboration, and operational excellence.


As an Al-First Quality Engineer, you will go beyond writing and executing test cases. You will harness the power of Al to predict defects, optimize test coverage, and accelerate delivery. You will play a pivotal role in shaping how intelligent quality practices are embedded into every stage of their software development lifecycle.


What You'll Do:

  • Use Al-driven tools to generate, maintain, and optimize test cases, test data, and test automation against application(s) running on the Salesforce Platform
  • Strategically prioritize and drive forward the QA practice with a high degree of autonomy

￮ Identify and propose strategies for technical and testing problems affecting the team, communicate standards clearly, and secure buy-in on solutions.

￮ Champion use of AI to automate repetitive and time-consuming QA tasks, freeing the team to focus on high-impact testing, exploratory scenarios, and strategic quality improvements

￮ Manage and mitigate technical and testing risk across projects, ensuring the right testing scope and sequencing to achieve team objectives and enable faster, safer releases.

￮ Leverage predictive analytics to identify defect-prone areas and prioritize risk-based testing.

  • Collaborate with developers, architects, and product managers to integrate Al-powered quality checks into CI/CD pipelines and unblock Al-powered workflows
  • Validate AI/ML based functionality for accuracy and reliability as part of the release process.


What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of proven experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles.

￮ Experience across the breadth of application testing types: end-to-end testing, load and volume performance testing, API testing, etc.

  • Proven experience with testing against the Salesforce Platform

￮ Understanding of platform and change management concepts: sandboxes, templates, packages, and changesets. Experience with Salesforce Second-Generation Managed Packages is strongly desired.

￮ Knowledge of platform limits and constraints to inform data volume testing

￮ Experience administering Salesforce and/or strong Salesforce configuration skills

  • Strong programming skills, with familiarity across several languages (C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, SQL, etc.).
  • Understanding of Al/ML concepts and hands-on experience using Al-enabled development and testing tools
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright preferred) and their intersection with Al tools (such as Playwright MCP Server)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud-native environments.
  • Self-driven work style, with initiative to exploring, learning, and applying novel concepts and techniques
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a mindset for experimentation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience in analyzing data sets for defect prediction, anomaly detection, or performing root cause analysis.


Work Schedule: You MUST be able to work during core U.S. Time Zone working hours.  


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a growing company at the forefront of Salesforce-driven enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Advanced English

Availability to relocate to Mexico after 3 months and remain there for the duration of the contract

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.

title: Staff Product Engineer (Software)
description:
Staff Product Engineer (Software)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Compensation: $60,000 USD / year

Annual Bonus: $6,000 (10%)

Backed By: Top Silicon Valley investors — Y Combinator, Liquid 2, Founder of Instacart, Founder of Reddit

Stage: High-growth consumer health tech subscription product generating $1M/month , compounding 15% MoM

TAM: $29.4B in the U.S. (100M people). ~600M people globally.

Career Growth: As our first full-time Staff Engineer , you will set engineering standards, establish technical direction, and grow the engineering team.


About the Job

As a Staff Software Engineer on Product , you will directly shape our customer-facing web app (tens of thousands of MAU) and own our highest-priority engineering initiatives. You’ll partner closely with the Product Designer, both Founders, and lead our engineering team to build reliable software that drives customer retention and product velocity.

You’ll spend ~75% of your time writing code and ~25% on technical direction, architectural decisions, and collaborating on the product roadmap .

You will operate in a Build → Measure → Learn + Iterate product loop.


About You

  • 8+ years building full-stack applications with Python and JavaScript
  • 4+ years of production React experience
  • Able to translate Figma designs into scalable React/Python implementations
  • Strong product-growth instincts and experience with event instrumentation
  • Skilled with PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar tools
  • Exceptional communicator who builds trust, aligns teams, and drives decisions
  • Staff-level depth: setting technical direction, making architectural tradeoffs, delivering impact
  • Adept at balancing technical debt, infra cost, engineering hours, and time-to-ship
  • Comfortable in fast-paced startup environments where engineers own infra end-to-end


Our Stack

  • Python (FastAPI) — backend
  • TypeScript (React) — frontend
  • Postgres (Supabase)
  • PostHog for product analytics
  • AWS
  • GitHub


What You’ll Do1. Build

  • Work with the Product Designer and Founders to define the technical direction
  • Translate customer feedback and Figma screens into clear technical requirements
  • Break down work across yourself + 2 Full-Stack Engineers + 1 AI Engineer
  • Own architecture, core features, and high-quality implementation
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the codebase

2. Measure

  • Instrument all necessary customer events inside our web app
  • Ensure PostHog receives clean, reliable data for evaluating retention and feature impact

3. Learn + Iterate

  • Partner with the Product Designer and CTO to build charts/dashboards in PostHog
  • Extract insights quickly to inform product decisions
  • Ship iterations rapidly and maintain a fast learning cycle

title: Estagiário
description:
Orgulho de ser Camil!


É com a força dos mais de 6 mil colaboradores presentes no Brasil, Uruguai, Chile, Peru e Equador que estamos rumo a um futuro promissor. Gente do passado, presente e futuro, foram e continuarão sendo fundamentais para a construção da nossa empresa que, sem deixar de ser simples, continua crescendo e inovando.


Estamos mais fortes do que nunca e acreditamos que através da riqueza que há nas pessoas, engajamos o nosso time para continuar alcançando os melhores resultados.


Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas e todos, independentemente da idade, deficiência, raça, gênero ou orientação sexual.


Venha construir uma carreira de sucesso!


#souarrozcomfeijão



Responsabilidades:

  • Análise e acompanhamento de KPI's: MAPE, BIAS, OTIF, CFR;
  • Avaliação de tendências, riscos e oportunidades para a malha de distribuição logística;
  • Desenvolvimento de Dashboards de indicadores de performance;
  • Apoiar na organização e análise de dados de estoques mitigando riscos de descarte;
  • Apoiar na manutenção de sistemas e ferramentas de planejamento;
  • Forte interação com as áreas: Vendas, Marketing, Produção e Logística.


Requisitos:

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Desejável conhecimento em SQL / Power BI;
  • Necessário conhecimento em Python;
  • Perfil analítico, proatividade e boa comunicação;
  • Interesse em Supply Chain e planejamento estratégico.

title: Global CRM Sustain & Operations Lead
description:
Global CRM Sustain & Operations Lead


As a Sustain & Operations Lead, you will be responsible for the management, quality, analysis, and lead of Global CRM system under your responsibility following the appropriate methodologies.


The functions are:


  • Provide Recommendations, Action Plans, and Status Updates to Leadership and Key Stakeholders
  • Manage Key Relationships with Business and Technical Stakeholders
  • Interaction with key users of the applications and Align application services with business goals to ensure efficiency and value delivery
  • Continually mature Sustain & Operational/Platform processes to meet Otis needs & requirements
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the production environment, ensuring system stability, performance, reliability & quality
  • Ensuring adherence to all policies, procedures, KPI’s, SLA’s, best practices are being properly tracked & completed. Continue to enhance & mature proper tracking/adherence with vendors/teams.
  • Focus, shorten & fine tune KPI’s to ensure internal teams are focused on correcting the area’s that provide most value
  • Enforce/champion/leverage & expand our AI usage/capabilities in day-to-day operations with internal sustain/workstream teams (includes vendors)
  • Continue to improve reports on support activities, incident trends, and system health for stakeholders
  • Promote continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements
  • Ensure/Drive Problem Management and follow best in class practices, implementing preventive measures and meeting Otis level objectives
  • Troubleshooting issues, coordinating with development teams, and implementing best practices for incident management and resolution
  • Ensure/enforce the integrity, data, administration, configuration, maintenance of all Global CRM environments (non-production & production)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, business analysts, cyber, infrastructure teams) to address complex technical challenges
  • Ensure/implement production monitoring for all integration system connected to production CRM & address any monitoring coverage gaps
  • Assist with new global initiatives with the Global CRM Implementation & Rollout COE team
  • Lead the audit/compliance initiatives for Global CRM, working with the auditing/compliance/DR teams
  • Approve /coordinate with appropriate teams/vendors on the environment server/maintenance upgrades/license management/platform items
  • Ensure proper documentation for system configurations, flow diagrams, troubleshooting steps, support processes & interfaces.
  • Push for automation and eliminate manual efforts.
  • Ensure adherence to IT security policies, data privacy regulations, and compliance standards
  • Ensure the integrity, environment synchronization, configuration, and maintenance of Global CRM environments (non-production & production)
  • Oversee/enhance usage of ITIL processes such as Incident Management, Change Management, and Service Delivery


Qualifications:


  • 5 years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Experience in ITLM
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Platform (Sales Module) highly preferred
  • Experience with MS Azure Dev Ops (ADO) tool preferred, but not required
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops with key stakeholders across multiple Functional Areas and Geographic Areas
  • Ability to understand and drive key decisions related to Technical Solutions based on feasibility, cost/benefit analysis, and complexity
  • Strong Leadership skills and experience leading Teams
  • Strong Interpersonal skills in areas related to teamwork, facilitation, collaboration, and negotiation
  • Strong Project Management skills in areas related to tracking project plans, managing resources, providing status updates, etc.
  • Ability to understand both the strategic ("big picture") and tactical perspectives of business problems and technical solutions
  • Highly organized and analytical
  • Very strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Exposure to multiple, diverse Business Systems and Technologies


Education level:


Bachelor’s Degree in Digital Technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Buscamos uma pessoa Product Owner apaixonada por dados, performance e qualidade, para atuar na evolução do ecossistema de relatórios em Data Fabric, garantindo integridade, governança e eficiência no consumo das informações.

Se você domina GraphQL, APIs, análise de payloads e backlog de produto, e gosta de ambientes ágeis, técnicos e colaborativos, esse desafio é a sua cara!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog de funcionalidades e histórias de usuário relacionadas ao consumo de dados e geração de relatórios.
  • Atuar como principal stakeholder na validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Definir padrões de requisição, resposta e manipulação de payloads complexos para consumo de APIs.
  • Construir e otimizar queries GraphQL para extração e composição dos dados no Orquestrador de Relatórios.
  • Trabalhar com Engenharia na definição de schemas, governança e padronização das APIs.
  • Liderar análises de dados migrados de sistemas legados, garantindo integridade e equivalência.
  • Definir e coordenar Testes de Equivalência (Equivalence Testing) entre legado e Data Fabric.
  • Colaborar com Data Stewards e Engenharia de Dados para entender origem, tratamento e disponibilização dos dados.
  • Conduzir discovery e refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo soluções escaláveis e performáticas.


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Proficiência em GraphQL API
  • Análise de payloads e arquivos .JSON
  • Data Quality Monitoring
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de cloud
  • Análise exploratória de datasets
  • Gerenciamento de backlog (Jira)
  • Planejamento de sprints e priorização
  • Criação de personas e histórias de usuário
  • Monitoramento de KPIs e OKRs
  • Visão de produto e definição de roadmap
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Experiência com Data Fabric ou arquiteturas distribuídas de dados
  • Background em migração de sistemas legados
  • Experiência com times de engenharia de dados, data stewardship e qualidade de dados
  • Conhecimento em modelos de dados e governança
  • Experiência no setor financeiro ou produtos de dados
  • Inglês avançado/fluente


Formato de trabalho: Remoto.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.


O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Perfil com forte senso de ownership e visão de dono da solução.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Transformar dados utilizando Azure Data Factory (ADF), incluindo criação e otimização de pipelines.
  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.


O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Perfil com forte senso de ownership e visão de dono da solução.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Tech Lead Back-End (Golang)
description:
Tech Lead Back-End | Golang | Startup B2B em Crescimento


Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Back-End para ser o pilar técnico e de liderança em nossa startup B2B em crescimento acelerado.


Se você é um(a) líder nato(a), pensa de forma analítica e quer ter autonomia total para moldar a arquitetura de um produto que está escalando clientes e soluções, essa é a sua chance de construir algo grande conosco!


O Desafio e o Seu Impacto


Você será a peça-chave na evolução técnica e estratégica do nosso produto. Seu foco será garantir que a tecnologia acompanhe a nossa curva de crescimento, transformando decisões técnicas em valor de negócio tangível.


Liderança e Mentoria: Liderar e apoiar diretamente um time de Back-End de 2 a 3 desenvolvedores(as).


Visão Estratégica: Definir e evoluir a arquitetura do produto, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e resiliência.


Qualidade e Performance: Estabelecer e fiscalizar padrões de código e boas práticas, assegurando que o produto seja robusto.


Ownership de Ponta a Ponta: Atuar com autonomia total para levar projetos desde a concepção arquitetural até a entrega em produção, em colaboração estreita com o Time de Produto.


Driver de Resultados: Garantir entregas consistentes, mantendo o foco em otimizar soluções para o contexto B2B.


Requisitos Essenciais:


Domínio em Golang (Avançado): Experiência robusta e aprofundada é imprescindível.


Experiência em Arquiteturas Escaláveis: Vivência na concepção e manutenção de APIs e sistemas de alto desempenho.


Experiência em Liderança: Histórico comprovado na liderança de pessoas ou times técnicos.


Ambiente Cloud: Conhecimento prático em qualquer provedor de Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).


Vivência em Startup/B2B: Experiência prévia em ambientes de startup ou com produtos B2B.


Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios):


Conhecimento em filas e mensagerias.


Experiência com GCP (Google Cloud Platform).

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Segurança Mobile  - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 17 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Analista de Segurança Mobile- Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Android: Kotlin/Java + Android Security (Keystore, FLAG_SECURE).
  • iOS: Swift/Objective-C + Keychain, Secure Enclave, snapshot protection.
  • Integração com React Native.
  • OWASP MASVS e OWASP Mobile Top 10.
  • Certificate Pinning e proteção de credenciais.
  • Ofuscação de código e prevenção contra engenharia reversa.
  • Experiência com SDKs de segurança embarcadas.
  • Vivência com JWT, OAuth 2.0;
  • Experiência em pipelines de CI/CD para apps mobile;
  • Criptografia aplicada: AES, RSA, SHA-256, HMAC, etc.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com segurança adaptativa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST e IAST para mobile.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de SSO entre múltiplos apps.
  • Experiência com integração de soluções de CAPTCHA e App Shielding.


Formação: Superior Completo ou em fase de conclusão até 2026 na área de TI



O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Android: Kotlin/Java + Android Security (Keystore, FLAG_SECURE).
  • iOS: Swift/Objective-C + Keychain, Secure Enclave, snapshot protection.
  • Integração com React Native.
  • OWASP MASVS e OWASP Mobile Top 10.
  • Certificate Pinning e proteção de credenciais.
  • Ofuscação de código e prevenção contra engenharia reversa.
  • Experiência com SDKs de segurança embarcadas.
  • Vivência com JWT, OAuth 2.0;
  • Experiência em pipelines de CI/CD para apps mobile;
  • Criptografia aplicada: AES, RSA, SHA-256, HMAC, etc.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com segurança adaptativa;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST e IAST para mobile.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de SSO entre múltiplos apps.
  • Experiência com integração de soluções de CAPTCHA e App Shielding.


Formação: Superior Completo ou em fase de conclusão até 2026 na área de TI



O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Google & YouTube Ads Growth Strategist – eCommerce Scaling Expert
description:
About Ad-Lab:

Ad-Lab is not your average performance marketing agency — we’re an elite e-commerce scaling engine. We’ve managed $150M+ in ad spend, scaled 100+ brands, and built a culture of high-performance and fast execution.

We’re looking for a Google & YouTube Ads Growth Strategist who’s already operated at the top 1% level — someone who’s scaled multiple e-commerce brands from $10k/month to $100k-$500k+ in ad spend, built and tested full-funnel strategies (PMAX, Shopping, YouTube, Search), and understands how to build, test, and scale cold traffic. You’re not here to manage — you’re here to make noise, break limits, and lead client success.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop & execute full-funnel strategies across Google Ads & YouTube for fast-growing DTC brands.
  • Lead account audits, scaling roadmaps, and creative testing cycles.
  • Scale PMAX and YouTube campaigns, optimize Shopping & Search, and unlock cold traffic profitability.
  • Guide clients on ad creative (scripts, angles, formats), funnel structure, CRO, and landing page strategy.
  • Direct landing page & advertorial builds (listicles, quizzes, VSLs).
  • Provide weekly performance reviews, client education, and action plans.


You’re a Fit If You:

  • Have scaled brands from $10k/month to $100k-$500k+ spend levels while maintaining ROAS.
  • Have hands-on experience managing $1M+/month in Google/YouTube ad spend.
  • Have built successful YouTube campaigns and know how to test hooks, CTAs, and audiences.
  • Are deeply analytical, fast-moving, and thrive on performance-based environments.
  • Know how to communicate with DTC founders, speak their language, and lead strategic direction.
  • Have worked in or alongside high-level CRO & creative testing environments.

title: Desenvolvedor Júnior (Microsoft Power Platform)
description:
Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de tecnologia, desenvolvimento ou afins;
  • Inglês Básico.


Habilidades Técnicas

  • Power BI, Power Automate e Power App;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software Web e banco de dados;
  • Experiência em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Habilidades em Python, JavaScript, React, html5, CSS3, construção de API e microserviços;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Programação de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando Power BI / Power Platform, bem como as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS .


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Modelagem de dados e estatística.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com as áreas de negócio na identificação dos requisitos, design e implantação da solução;
  • Criar fluxos automatizados entre aplicações e serviços utilizando o Microsoft Power Platform: Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate e Power Pages;
  • Desenvolver e manter Dashboards no Microsoft Power BI;
  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant to join our Global D365 Blueprint Maintenance Team. This role focuses on supporting L3 and L4 bug fixes and managing change requests related to localization and legal requirements in the LATAM market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Finance modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Cash & Bank, Tax.
  • Ensure compliance with Finance Localizations for South America, primarily Brazil and Argentina.
  • Collaborate with global teams to maintain and enhance the D365 blueprint.
  • Address change requests arising from localization or legal changes.


Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of D365 Finance modules and ERP lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of financial principles and accounting standards.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps. Familiarity with Power Platform is a plus.
  • Proficiency in documentation and stakeholder communication.
  • Advanced English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work slightly earlier hours for overlap with CET (8 AM – 5 PM).


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect



Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws
